headline: Colombia October Producer Prices Rise 4.54% Year-on-Year
summary: Producer prices in Colombia increased by 4.54% year-on-year in October, exceeding forecasts as mining, oil, and food prices climbed.
why: Producer price inflation serves as an early indicator of consumer price trends and guides monetary policy decisions by Banco de la República.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Higher-than-expected producer inflation suggests lingering cost pressures across mining and agricultural sectors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
